input.feature_scope: Official Train only; no Test or SampleSubmission access

parent.bag_channel: Frozen C2_B prefix-only TF-IDF vectorizer, unigram tokenization, BAG_LR coefficients and original fit/score base matrices
parent.reused_prediction: Original POS_BAG_OFFSET pP; A02 predictions through explicit non-target array keys only

feature_definition.tokenization: Frozen C2_B vectorizer build_preprocessor/build_tokenizer; all token occurrences, including out-of-vocabulary tokens, determine position indices
feature_definition.position: For n>1 and zero-based i, u=2*i/(n-1)-1; h1=u; h2=(3*u^2-1)/2 minus the mean over every document token. For n<=1, h1=h2=0.
feature_definition.bag_weight: a_t=(1+log(c_t))*frozen_IDF_t over known unigram tokens; B_t=a_t/L2(a)
feature_definition.moments: m1_t and m2_t are means over positions for occurrences of known token t; OOV tokens have no feature column but remain in position and h2-centering calculations.
feature_definition.normalization: Concatenate [B,B*m1,B*m2], then L2-normalize the entire row once. Zero when no known unigram exists.
feature_definition.shuffled_control: Apply deterministic_order_shuffle to token order with seed 42; preserve bag and token count; rebuild h1/h2.

learner.fixed_offset: z0 = original BAG_LR intercept + original Xbase @ beta, float64 logit
learner.acceptance: Optimizer success, finite objective/gradient/coefficients, final objective <= zero-gamma objective + 1e-8; no retry or rescue.

policy.deployment_candidate: REAL only; shuffled is matched control

gates.primary_gain_vs_MIX50: REAL fixed-policy Macro F1 gain >= 0.0005 on E67 H12 and E75 W6
gates.matched_shuffled: REAL fixed-policy Macro F1 >= SHUFFLED fixed-policy Macro F1 on E67 H12 and E75 W6
gates.E67_subwindows: REAL fixed-policy Macro F1 harm <= 0.003 vs MIX50 on W4, W5, W6
gates.subgroups: For supported n>=200, positive>=30, negative>=30 groups over availability, entry_friction, and prefix-only text_load quartiles: Macro F1 harm <=0.01 and positive-recall harm <=0.02; unsupported groups are UNKNOWN, not PASS or FAIL.

interpretation: Adaptive temporal Train diagnostic; E67/E75 overlap on cycles 76-79. No causal or public-score claim. E79 requires separate Sol review.
